title: Not a Loot Crate
text: This is not what it sounds like. My girl has been asking for a subscription box, the description of this item says "box" and yet it is only 1 bag with 1 item. She received a Marvel comics romper and that was it. The description of this "box" is completely misleading. Do not subscribe and I would recommend looking elsewhere. She was fortunate not to receive the crappy bag in other reviews but if this is the type of items anyone could receive in the future I would stay clear. You have been warned.
label: negative
